notes.title: Ver. 1.16.10 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Wizardry Variants Daphne.

Ver. 1.16.10 has been released.

--------------------------------------------------------
◆Special Supplies◆
--------------------------------------------------------
Log in during the event period to receive special supplies, including a total of 2 Unique Remains: Golden Beast Dancing Maiden and 400 Gems of Org.

[Event Period]
9/25/2025 (16:00) - 10/15/2025 (23:59) JST

[How to Claim]
Rewards can be claimed from Adventurer's Guild > Supplies > Special Supplies.

*You can claim up to 7 days' worth of unclaimed rewards at once during the event period.

--------------------------------------------------------
◆Offer Up the Sacred Flame Missions◆
--------------------------------------------------------
Complete designated limited-time missions during the event period to earn points and receive special rewards, such as up to 2 Unique Remains: Golden Beast Dancing Maiden, 400 Gems of Org, and more.

[Event Period]
9/25/2025 (16:00) - 10/8/2025 (23:59) JST

[Offer up the Sacred Flame Mission Pass Introduction]
In conjunction with Offer Up the Sacred Flame Missions, a Offer up the Sacred Flame Mission Pass will be available for purchase.

With a Mission Pass, you can obtain additional rewards on top of standard mission rewards, such as up to 3 Unique Remains: Golden Beast Dancing Maiden (with bonus) and 150 Gems of Org.

*For reward details, please see the treasure chest on the Offer Up the Sacred Flame Mission screen.
*The Offer Up the Sacred Flame Missions can be purchased from the Jeweler under Adventurer's Passport.
*Even if you have purchased the Offer Up the Sacred Flame Mission Pass, you must complete the missions during the event period and claim the rewards from the mission screen to receive them.

--------------------------------------------------------
[Bugs Fixed]
--------------------------------------------------------
Regarding the following equipment obtainable as bonuses, we had restricted taking into account the traits of each, their use to certain classes only, but this fact was not clearly explained. We sincerely apologize.

- Quicksilver Crosier (Two-Handed Staff)
- Skeleton Lady's Hat (Hat)
- Skeleton Lady's Gloves (Gloves)
Since our explanation was insufficient, we have adjusted the affected equipment so that it can now be equipped by the same classes as other items of the same type. In addition, a future update will allow you to check which classes can equip an item directly from the equipment screen.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused.

- Attack Power may decrease when equipped with the Digging Mattock tool.

- There was an error in the description of Scroll of Swiftness's effect.

- When checking the effect while using the Scroll of Swiftness, a different item name was displayed.

Additionally, we have individually corrected user data for the following resolved issues.

- On certain floors of the Old Castle Ruins, the Foray Speed may not be saved correctly.
*Foray Speed may end up being recorded as '0'.

- When adventurers of different styles are merged, their unique skills activate simultaneously.

- In certain cases, the Overall Mastery was not applied correctly, and Discipline Skills did not take effect.

- Some merged adventurers displayed a higher Overall Mastery value than intended.

- Various other issues have been addressed.

Event periods and contents are subject to change without any prior notice.

Lastly, as an apology for the inconvenience and trouble caused by the various issues, the following has been sent to all players.

- Gem of Org x1,000

We hope you continue to enjoy playing Wizardry Variants Daphne.

--------------------------------------------------------
"Two of my fellow alchemists who went to the black market have not returned. Maybe you could at least recover their belongings?"

A hidden power dwells within the Relics of the Abyss. An eccentric alchemist, devoted to its research comes a request to investigate the Abyss depths.

The Relics of the Abyss remain shrouded in mystery, even serving at times as research material for mages. Fulfilling the alchemist's request could uncover the secrets of their enigma.

--------------------------------------------------------

*If this issue persists, please contact support with details of your device.

- The update download confirmation screen incorrectly shows a larger file size.

- When installing updates, a portion of the data may be unnecessarily redownloaded.

- When equipping a weapon with a bonus effect in one hand using the Ninja Dual Wield skill, the effect incorrectly triggers for both hands.
*The effect should only trigger when the bonus effect weapon hits.

- [Skill] Concealment (Level 7): The evasion rate without armor is lower than intended.

- [Skill] Divine Path (Level 2–3): Attack Power and Magic Power scaling is lower than intended.

- [Skill] Untyped Thaumaturgy: Damage from CONES and MACONES may not be reduced.

- [Skill] ZILFIS & ABIT: Effects at certain skill levels differ from their descriptions.

- [Skill] Eye of Kalshum: The detailed description does not mention the Detect scaling effect by skill level.

- [Skill] Armor Pierce: The Defense Penetration weapon trait does not activate when the skill is used.

- When using a skill that reduces action speed, the action order is displayed as slowed down.

- Under certain conditions, Rinne’s skill inheritance screen shows a lower combat power.
*This is a display-only issue.

- Bind Tolerance does not increase after learning Bind Tolerance Up (Mind).

- [Equipment] Circlet: The status affliction tolerance effect is lower than intended.

- [Item] Scroll of Eruption: The attack type is set to Dark Type.

- [Skill] True Eye Stance: The English skill description has been adjusted to match actual effects.

- After the True Words of Fire skill is inherited, increasing its skill level does not enhance the Accuracy and Defense Power reduction effects.

- The level 4 description for the Astral Break skill lists fewer turns of Action Speed Up than intended.

- The level 4 REINIKUS skill heals less HP than intended

- At level 5 or higher, the KUSFIS skill fails to remove Spell-Bind from allies other than the selected target.

- The Sanctuary's Blessing skill incorrectly shows levels 2 to 7.
*The skill is only available at level 1.

- The Kunoichi Self-Discipline skill's detailed description is the same as its short description.

- Learning or leveling up the Kunoichi Self-Discipline skill does not increase Evade Trap stat as intended.

- A skill's detail screen may show a level 7 button, even if the skill's level cap is lower.

- Equipping multiple items with the same status affliction resistance effects does not stack.

- Chloe's passive skill, Interpersonal Combat Technique, has been renamed to Anti-Adventurer Combat Technique.
*No changes have been made to the skill's effects.

- Corrected the English translation of the Cresting Wave Stance skill to match its intended effects.

- Various other issues have been addressed.

Event periods and contents are subject to change without any prior notice.

We hope you will continue to enjoy and support Wizardry Variants Daphne.

--------------------------------------------------------
◆Feature Improvements◆
--------------------------------------------------------
- Text/Voice Language Selection Feature Added
The in-game text and voice languages can now be set separately via Options > Language.

- Party Management Feature Added
A Party Management feature has been added under Guild Tavern > Edit.
[How to Use]
1. On the party screen, select New Party to save the current formation (e.g., Party A).
2. On the same screen, while Party A is selected, tap Assemble Party at the bottom the screen.
3. The active party will be updated to the Party A setup.

*Registered parties include settings such as inventory items. Be sure to check the confirmation message before switching.

For more details, please refer to Guild Tavern > Edit > Party.

--------------------------------------------------------
◆Actions Taken Against Misconduct◆
--------------------------------------------------------
We have retrieved Gems of Org that were repeatedly obtained by exploiting a bug in the Light Shield Material Collection request.

In cases where players were found to have intentionally repeated the exploit multiple times, we have enforced account suspensions accordingly.

Please be advised that confirmed use of bugs for unfair advantage may result in account suspension or other penalties, as outlined in our Terms of Service. If you encounter any potentially unintended behavior such as this issue, we kindly ask that you refrain from using it and report it to Customer Support.

*This is a display-only issue.

Event periods and contents are subject to change without any prior notice.

--------------------------------------------------------
◆Blacksmith Feature Improvements◆
--------------------------------------------------------
- Adjustments to Additional Blessing Enhancements
When an Additional Blessing refined with a Refinement Stone is enhanced through equipment enhancement, the refinement effect will now be retained.

- New Item: Refinement Stone Fragment
There is now a chance to obtain Refinement Stone Fragments when extraction fails. By collecting 500 fragments, you can trade them for one Refinement Stone of your choice. To see the list of exchangeable Refinement Stones, please check the Refinement Stones tab under Exchange.
*Having an active Adventurer's Passport or Adventurer's Elite Passport increases the amount of Refinement Stone Fragments obtained.
As part of this update, players who created an account before the 7/10/2025 maintenance will receive the following.
- Refinement Stone Fragments x3,000

--------------------------------------------------------
◆Full Alteration Stone Improvements◆
--------------------------------------------------------
Full Alteration Stones allow all Additional Blessings on equipment to be changed. In rare occasions, it may produce blessings that exceed the equipment's latent abilities. However, as Full Alteration Stones are extremely rare items, we recognize that opportunities to use them have been limited. Additionally, using a Full Alteration Stone resets any Additional Blessing Enhancements gained through equipment enhancement. As a result, they must be used before enhancing an item, which in turn restricts when they can be used.

To address these issues, we intend to apply the following adjustments.

- Addition of Lesser Full Alteration Stones
Lesser Full Alteration Stones do not grant additional blessings that exceed the equipment's latent abilities. However, we have increased their availability slightly compared to regular Full Alteration Stones, so they can be used more conveniently for altering blessings. Like Full Alteration Stones, they may rarely be obtained when extracting equipment.

- When using Full Alteration Stones or Lesser Full Alteration Stones, any Additional Blessing Enhancement that was applied through equipment enhancement will now also enhance the newly applied Additional Blessing. We hope this change allows for more opportunities to enhance favorite equipment without being restricted by the equipment's enhancement state.

Also, with the addition of Lesser Full Alteration Stones, the icon for Full Alteration Stones has been adjusted.

For more details, please refer to Options > Help.

A new Compendium feature has been added, where you can view records of characters you have met, equipment collected, monsters defeated, and more.

*The Compendium can be accessed via the log icon at the bottom the screen.
*As of Ver. 1.7.10, characters that can be viewed in 'Characters' are those appearing through the Beginning Abyss. Characters met after the Beginning Abyss will be added in future updates.

4/17/2025 (17:00) JST

5/2/2025 (0:00) - 5/6/2025 (23:59) JST

--------------------------------------------------------
[Bugs Fixed]
--------------------------------------------------------
- Characters who die in battle and are revived using the Right Hand of Reversal continue to lose Fortitude after the battle ends.

- Accepting the Procuring Food for Dogs request while progressing through the Search for the Missing Girl request causes progression to become impossible.

- Under certain conditions, leaping to a point after Infiltrating the Fortress in the Cursed Wheel may not be possible.

- Treasure chests that should reappear over time in dungeons do not appear.

- Repeatedly pressing the Move to Nearest Exit and Auto-Move on the minimap at the same time causes the game to freeze.

- The Right Hand of Reversal cannot be used on certain objects in B3F -Cave-In Zone- of the Beginning Abyss.

- The status-enhancing effect from the Lord of the Deep Forest's Leadership skill does not activate.

- Damage falloff based on range is incorrectly applied to the Moment of Finality skill.

- The priest-specific passive skill Sacred Blessing unintentionally activates for non-priest classes.

- Certain skills cannot be used while ninja katanas or katanas are equipped.

- Equipment that inflicts status afflictions or race-slayer effects may trigger from certain skills or spell attacks.

- The status affliction effects from equipment are applied every tick from Blood Edge's continuous damage.

- Under certain conditions, the Secret Art of LAFOROS skill can be used without restriction during battle.

- Equipping armor with the Undead Resistance trait may cause increased damage from undead enemies.

- Merging characters with optional skills that are level 1 or below and have skill experience causes an error.

- The total drop rate for Junk which includes Stealth Garb does not equal 100%.

- The Help entry for Merge contains an error.
*The bonus points are inherited from the base adventurer.

We apologize for the confusion caused by the incorrect information in the Help section. For players who performed merges prior to this correction, we are currently reviewing possible compensation and will follow up at a later date.

- Various other issues have been addressed.

--------------------------------------------------------
[Feature Adjustments]
--------------------------------------------------------
- Character merging has been adjusted so that a portion of the experience is not lost.
*This was originally intended as a soft-progression reset, but it has been removed in consideration of the overall gameplay experience.

Event periods and contents are subject to change without any prior notice.

We hope you will continue to enjoy and support Wizardry Variants Daphne.
